تقتصدين (form VIII)
# تَقْتَصِدِينَ (taqtaṣidīna) /taq.ta.sˤi.diː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past active indicative of اِقْتَصَدَ (iqtaṣada)
# تُقْتَصَدِينَ (tuqtaṣadīna) /tuq.ta.sˤa.diː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive indicative of اِقْتَصَدَ (iqtaṣada)
